rows.grounds: optative verb expressing injunction to utter or recite
genitive dependent indicating the mantra to be recited
dative of purpose; compound of puraścaraṇa and siddhi

items.question: What ritual accomplishment is secured by reciting the specified mantra?
premises: Recitation of a mantra is enjoined as a ritual act.
The mantra in question is designated as a specific one.
The stated aim of this recitation is success in preliminary rites.
items.inference: Reciting the specified mantra serves to accomplish the preliminary rite.
uncertainties: The identity of the specified mantra is not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should recite the specified mantra for the successful accomplishment of the preliminary rite.
